Subject: Evidence request: entropy sources + HSM attestation + rotation window

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our vendor SIG/SOC2 review we need a small bundle of cryptographic evidence focused on key material practices before we can move to the final procurement stage. Could you confirm whether Redwood can provide the following by EOD next week?

- HSM attestation (vendor and version, FIPS/PA attestations) and date-of-last-audit
- Measured entropy samples or randomness-source measurements for the key generation process (summary CSV is fine)
- Current KMS configuration snapshot (key policies, TTLs, key usage flags)
- TLS in-transit cert chain proof for public endpoints (CN and expiry)
- Key rotation SLA and emergency rotation runbook (who is authorized, estimated RTO for rotation)

We are aiming for minimal scope: a handful of signed artifacts and a short runbook. If anything requires a non-disclosure step or extra paperwork please call that out and we can expedite.

Best,
Lisa

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Evidence request: entropy sources + HSM attestation + rotation window

Hi Lisa / Marissa — technical clarifications below to set expectations for the artifacts: 

- HSM: We use Thales Luna SA 7.x (FIPS 140-2 Level 3 certified on our hosted Dedicated clusters). We can provide the vendor attestation PDF and the last-seal date (2027-11-10).

- Entropy: Key material is provisioned inside the HSM; entropy is derived from the HSM TRNG. We can export a sampled entropy measurement log (lightweight CSV) showing byte-distribution and timestamps for recent key ceremonies. The CSV will be accompanied by a README describing sample size and tooling (entropy-checker v1.2).

- KMS snapshot: We'll provide an exported snapshot of logical key metadata (no raw key material). Snapshot fields: key_id, creation_ts, rotation_policy (auto/manual), last_rotated_ts, allowed_uses, binding_roles. We'll redact internal hostnames but include role bindings and policy text.

- In-transit/TLS: We host inference endpoints behind managed load balancers; certs are issued by DigiCert and managed via our cert automation. We'll supply the cert chain and a signed statement of TLS parameters (minimum TLS1.2, modern ciphers).

- Rotation SLA/runbook: Standard schedule is automatic rotation every 12 months for customer tenant master keys; per-tenant KEKs can be rotated on-demand. Emergency rotation playbook includes: authorization matrix, emergency key generation steps inside HSM, re-wrapping steps, and rollback guidance. Estimated emergency rotation RTO: 2-4 hours for metadata rotation; full tenant re-wrap could be longer depending on dataset size — we'll include measured windows.

Attachments I will prepare: hsm_attestation.pdf, hsm_entropy_measurement.csv, kms-config-snapshot-20280407.json, emergency-rotation-playbook.pdf.

If Horizon needs live evidence (e.g., witness of generation or live inspection), please state that explicitly — that requires scheduling and additional NDAs.

Irene Choi
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai
